name: Husqvarna T525
blurb: 12″ bar on 3/8″ low profile chain, .050″ gauge, 45 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: The T525 is a top-handle arborist saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 1 bar and chain combinations for the T525: 12″. Pitch on those rows: 3/8″ low profile. Gauge: .050″. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 12″ setup with bar Laminate 596009745 and chain S93G X-Cut 585422145.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 5 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
